messages:
alex: Starting intake for cassiopeia-9b (9B). Goal: int8 quantized build for A100/GPU fleets. Target p95 latency <= 250ms for 512 tokens on hosted; dedicated pool target <= 120ms. Cost target: ~35-50% lower than fp16 baseline. Planning hosted + dedicated canary (priority: hosted first, then dedicated). Need owners: quant (maria), evals (jay), infra (tess), rollout lead (sanjay). :eyes:

maria: assigned to quant experiments. I'll run int8-with-nnq + per-channel calibration. Will produce baseline vs fp16 SFT and a short "artifact checklist" (tokenization drift, topk artifacts, repeated tokens).

jay: will prepare eval suite: promptsets: search-queries-v2, convo-evals, hallucination-smoke. Metric thresholds: delta Rouge <= 1.5, intent F1 drop <= 2%, hallucination rate <= 0.5% absolute increase. Also set up golden prompts + pairwise sampling. cc @tess for perf harness.

tess: infra - can spin up dedicated pool. Need container image tag, model artifact S3 path, and warmup script. Also: propose canary routing policy: 3% hosted -> 10% after 4h if metrics ok -> ramp to 30% then swap. For dedicated: start 10% reserved burst, keep autoscaling cap at 60% of pool.

sanjay: rollout owner. I'll coordinate canary windows. Add rollback rules: autopause on latency breach or regression > thresholds. Suggest fallback model: "cassiopeia-9B-fp16-v1" and "harrier-lite" as last resort.

alex: here's quick routing config snippet for deployers:
```
route: cassiopeia-9b
policies:
  - name: hosted_canary
    traffic: [ {pool: hosted, pct: 3}, {pool: fallback, pct: 97} ]
  - name: progressive_ramp
    steps: [ {wait: 4h, increase_to: 10}, {wait: 8h, increase_to: 30} ]
```
Also attach calibrations: s3://redwood-models/cassiopeia/9b/int8/2026-03-20/

maria: initial int8 smoke runs: topk logits look fine but observed tokenization edge-case in legal prompts (double commas). Will add calibration set with long-tail tokens. Running evals now.

jay: first eval pass (1000 prompts): Rouge delta 0.9, hallucination +0.6% (slightly over threshold), latency p95 hosted 280ms (miss by 30ms). Notes: quantization appears to increase hallucination on fact-dense prompts. Logging per-prompt diffs to /evals/cassiopeia/2103009999/results.csv

tess: infra note: A100 kernel variant used is cudnn 9.1; try switching kernel variant kernel-v2 for perf. Repro: run `deploy-tool warmup --image cassio:9b-int8 --warmup-script warmup.lua --retries 2`

sanjay: decision: hold ramp. Actions: maria to re-run calibration with extended context, jay to re-evaluate focus on hallucination prompts, tess to test kernel-v2. Check-in in 3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: canary-started 2103010200: hosted canary at 3% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: calibration updated: added long-tail tokens and legal prompt augmentations. Re-ran. Hallucination delta now +0.3%. p95 latency improved to 240ms after float->int8 kernel path tweak.

jay: rerun full eval: Rouge delta 1.1, hallucination +0.28%, intent F1 -1.1%. All within thresholds. Recommend progressive ramp with additional monitoring for legal prompts.

tess: kernel-v2 + mem-config reduced p95 to 220ms. Dedicated pool warmup still pending (need disk image approval), ETA 6h.

sanjay: plan: proceed with progressive ramp. Schedule canary window tonight 00:00-04:00 UTC for next steps. Rollout playbook: if any metric exceeds threshold for 15m, autoswitch to fallback pool. If rollback needed, deploy-bot will annotate thread. Assigning oncall: @maria for quality, @tess infra, @jay evals.

alex: noted. I'll update onboarding doc and runbook. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary-update 2103010620: hosted traffic at 10%. No alerts.
